findings.text: Ask 4 says the demo happens "in a session": "add a tab here" makes a tab appear with no reload. The shots only show `/framework/core/Page/tool/`, a plain page. No session page was shot with an agent-added tab, so the session half of the demo has no proof. The code path for it exists (`AISessionDetail.Log` → `Page.overlay()`, plus `column_host()` letting a tab open inside the session column).

On the new Page tool page, the padding stacked at the left of a paragraph is 75px at 400, about 4.7em; the limit is 3em (spacing 33). It is also four nested layers deep (spacing 34). Evidence: layout.json `left_stack.p` 75 = page-content-row 19 + page-content-list 14 + page-canvas 14 + page 28. The cause is the content-list styling the page inherits, not this diff, but this page is the demo.

Ask 4 says sessions and VS Code tabs "get a name (slug) where they lack one". A session with no folder gets `session-<id8>/`, which is an id fragment, not a name. Nothing in the diff gives a session or a VS Code tab a real name.

At 3440 the Page tool page is one narrow column of cards placed just right of the sidebar, with about 80% of the screen empty (layout 1, 10). Evidence: `shots/…core-Page-tool/3440.png`; layout.json empty 0.83, page-frame ink 0.164.

`Frame.js` changes every page that has `navigation: "tabs"` plus content of its own: that content now becomes a first "Overview" tab instead of sitting above the tab strip. Only two pages were shot. `ext/Refine/page.js` records an older bug that this probably fixes, but no other tabbed page was checked.

Ask 1 asks for a list of readme fixes in the task log. The task log has one line saying "no major errors". `core/Page/readme.md` did gain a storage-and-streaming index and a link to `architecture.md`, but those additions are not listed as fixes.

The cards on the Page tool page explain the delta language in prose, with raw JSON inside the sentences (words 1, 11). A code block per example, or the live log shown beside the result, would show it instead of telling it.
